scope: Read-only forensic analysis of retained stage31 many512_pose samples; no GPU rerun and no source mutation.

timing_semantics.total: Session run wall clock; excludes decode, construction, serialization.
timing_semantics.proposal: Starts with Session run and includes prepare; do not add prepare again.
timing_semantics.refine: Includes pose creation on first call and GPU refinement wait plus CPU verification.
timing_semantics.fine_ncc: Includes fused warp+NCC command wait and fine normalization; do not add fused_wait or fused_device to it.
timing_semantics.fine_rotation: In fused mode excludes fused command NCC/wait interval, includes planning, warp encode, repair.
timing_semantics.fused_wait: CPU wall wait for whole fused command; includes device interval; its difference from device time is not a transfer measurement.
timing_semantics.coarse_wait: CPU wall wait; contains coarse GPU device interval.
timing_semantics.normalization: CPU-executed wall-time scope, not measured CPU consumption; scheduling/interrupt time can be included.
timing_semantics.fine_stats_device: Unavailable sentinel -1 in fused mode, not a negative duration.

proven: The original +48.33986857% comparison is current_legacy block1 repeat versus frozen block1 repeat; same-build current_legacy block0 repeat is near frozen and direct repeats.
All twelve first/repeat records have identical ordered 512 matches and 1301 proposals, all reported non-clock work counters and corresponding-phase capacities are identical.
Almost all excess is in proposal, predominantly the scale=1.0 model. CPU coarse normalization wall time and GPU command device intervals both increase.
The outlier is a repeat: pose_create_ms=0 and pose_conversion_temporary_bytes=0. Decode occurs before Session and cannot directly be a repeated decode inside the anomalous timer.
The outlier whole-process peak RSS is not unusually high among old-loader workers; direct-loader process RSS remains lower.
not_proven: No contemporaneous thermal/power/CPU-process schedule/page-fault/compression timeline was retained; do not identify OS scheduling, thermal throttling, contention, page faults or transfer as the confirmed cause.
Identical work/results/capacities excludes a visible extra-search workload or accuracy change but does not exclude hidden runtime/program performance issues.
One first and one repeat in two blocks is insufficient to distinguish a rare program latency issue from environmental variability or quantify an outlier probability.
A wait-minus-device difference is not CPU-to-GPU transfer time and may include queueing, scheduling, runtime and wakeup overhead.

minimum_reproduction_design.outlier_recheck: Frozen, current legacy, current direct; same exact retained input/config/binaries; 4 fresh serial-process blocks with predeclared balanced/reversed order; first plus5 consecutive repeats, no warmup, preserve all observations. This keeps the original first/repeat transition and gives60 repeats+12first calls, not independent image accuracy cases.
minimum_reproduction_design.instrumentation: Add monotonic call/phase timestamps, current/peak RSS and physical footprint, process user/system CPU time, minor/major faults and thermal/power snapshot where available; gather lightweight host load/process context outside timed algorithm. Never infer unavailable fields as zero. Per-model wall boundaries help localize future stalls; detailed Metal profiler separately if they recur.
minimum_reproduction_design.accuracy: Keep strict ordered proposal/final equality, non-time counters and capacities per phase, same GT zero FP/FN criteria; save raw hashes and failed pairs.
minimum_reproduction_design.decision: If no comparable stall recurs, report not reproduced inN calls, consistent with transient timing variability; do not declare original root cause known or program definitively fault-free. If recurrent, separate model normalize CPU wall vsCPUusage and queue/device/wakeup using timeline evidence.
